content:
anna: :rotating_light: Found plaintext creds in partner webhook deliver logs (staging). snippet contains GCS SA key id + a wrapped blob. Need a quick containment + rotation plan. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4789

mike: ugh. where in staging? can you paste the grep output (no creds) and the exact vault path if any?

anna: grep showed `partner/webhooks/ingest` in logs-prod-archive, and payload included `gcs_key_id: projects/-/serviceAccounts/partner-ingest@...` and `wrapped_blob: ci-wrap-enc:v1` (not the plaintext). I redacted the key material.

liam: good. immediate plan: 1) rotate any SA that matches id in partner project 2) rewrap/unseal any Vault-stored ciphertext referencing that blob 3) audit log enabling and RBAC harden for the partner webhook path 4) schedule 1-hr containment window now. who can take 1+2?

mike: I can run the rewrap/rewrap-checks and coordinate SA rotation with infra. Steps I propose:
```
# list vault entries referencing blob
vault kv list secret/partner/webhooks || true
# rewrap ciphertext to new wrap key
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key ci-wrap-enc:v1
```
I'll run in a dry-run first, then rewrap for real.

anna: assigned to @mike for rewrap and to @liam for SA rotation and RBAC rule changes. i'll open a short incident ticket and set PD notification. ticket SEC-4789 created.

liam: for SA rotation I'll open a partner request (they own the SA) and also rotate any staging service accounts we control that accepted that SA. plan: request rotation + rotate internal service account creds that reference the partner key. ETA 45m.

vault-bot: audit: enabled request/response logging on secret/partner/webhooks at 2026-03-23T15:02:12Z.

mike: quick checklist I'm following:
- snapshot vault metadata for secret/partner/webhooks
- rewrap ciphertext via transit to new-wrap-key-v2
- rotate any kv entries that contain wrapped_blob references (update to new ciphertext)
- push rollout to staging service that reads this path

anna: RBAC note: we'll add a policy lock to deny update/create on secret/partner/webhooks except for role=platform-deploy. liam, can you make that change as a short-lived emergency policy? then we'll roll to more conservative groups.

liam: yes. policy snippet I'll apply (emergency):
```
path "secret/partner/webhooks/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
path "secret/partner/webhooks/rotate" {
  capabilities = ["update"]
  allowed_roles = ["platform-ops"]
}
```
apply and audit. I'll note change in SEC-4789.

mike: ran dry-run rewrap, no errors, listing shows new ciphertext preview. executing rewrap now.

mike: :white_check_mark: rewrap completed. updated kv entries to reference new-wrap-key-v2 ciphertext. pushing redeploy to staging webhook consumer.

sre-bot: deploy: webhook-consumer-staging v2.4.1 started rolling at 2026-03-23T15:18:40Z.

anna: liam, confirm partner engagement and SA rotation ticket? we should also ask partner to rotate any keys that were in plaintext on their side and provide proof of rotation (paste new key id).

liam: partner contacted, they acknowledged and will rotate within 30m. asked for proof and revocation of old key. raised internal ticket to rotate our staging SA creds that accepted the webhook (owner: infra).

mike: QA: verified webhook-consumer staging can decrypt new ciphertext and requests succeed locally. no errors in logs after redeploy.

vault-bot: vault-audit: 23 new requests to secret/partner/webhooks recorded during containment window. logs forwarded to Splunk index sec-audit.

anna: follow-ups: 1) schedule RBAC postmortem to tighten partner on-boarding checks 2) add a presubmit linter to scan for inserted plaintext SA keys in webhook payloads (devex) 3) close SEC-4789 after partner confirms rotation and infra rotates internal SA.

liam: will run postmortem and assign action items. thanks @mike and everyone.

mike: thanks. marking this thread resolved unless we see more alerts.

anna: resolved for now, leaving incident ticket open until partner rotation confirmed. :lock:
